card.name: Inside split rare names and words
card.fires_on: Fires on a middle piece of a longer, rarely seen word or name that is split into parts, such as 'item' in recruitment or 'YM' in a brand name. It also fires on short abbreviations in parentheses.

modes.label: Middle of split words
modes.description: A piece like 'item' or 'im' sits inside a longer word or name that continues after it.
modes.example: do not need any more recru<<item>>ents, or the trial may be completed

modes.label: Inside brand names and acronyms
modes.description: A piece inside a drug brand name or an abbreviation in parentheses.
modes.example: Co-administration of PREV<<YM>>IS with drugs that are inhibitors of O

card.writes: The promoted pieces are word endings like 'anager' and 'ettes', suggesting it helps finish a partly spelled word.
card.plain: It marks the middle of an unusual long word or name that the model has to spell out in pieces.
